changes: Scribe's name re-read: 'pada (!) nāmabhidho' is most likely a corruption of 'padmanābhābhidho' ('named Padmanābha'); name set to Padmanābha (medium confidence) instead of 'Pada'.
Gotra corrected to Kauṇḍinya (the colophon has 'kauḍinya') and recorded as a gotra affiliation.
Title normalized: 'dvijendo' is read as dvijendra, an epithet for a brahmin, not an office.
Purpose rendered as copying for the study of his son(s) ('ātmajādeḥ pāṭhāya').
Date: the month is solar (the sun in Meṣa). The chronogram is still unresolved and is not converted to CE. Notes explain the ambiguous segmentation of 'pāṭhāyamedhābde'.

persons.name: Padmanābha
persons.evidence: kauḍinya vaṃśodbhava pada (!) nāmabhidho dvijendo likhyad

purpose: for the study of his son(s) etc. (ātmajādeḥ pāṭhāya)
notes: The colophon is a corrupt metrical verse, roughly: kauṇḍinyavaṃśodbhava-padmanābhābhidho dvijendro 'likhad ātmajādeḥ pāṭhāya ... śakābde nepāladeśe meṣarāśisthite 'rke. 'pada (!) nāmabhidho' is taken as padmanābhābhidho, but this reading is conjectural. The Śaka year is given as a word-numeral chronogram that is corrupt: 'pāṭhāyamedhābde mite (!)' is ambiguous. It could be pāṭhāya + medhā-abde, or it could hide number words (e.g. yama = 2), so no year is given and ce_approx is left blank. 'Meṣarāśisthite 'rke' means the sun was in Aries (solar Vaiśākha). The son (ātmaja) for whom the copy was made is not named.
